correctness.rationale: PASS: The face criterion (mixed face size<=r, all one-part faces) gives the exact skeleton-plus-two-simplices decomposition. The reduced simplicial boundary as augmentation contraction identifies top skeleton cycles with Λ^r U_V; the relative sequence injects the two part exterior powers. An integral difference basis U_V=U_A⊕U_B⊕Z(e_a-e_b) makes both sublattices disjoint primitive blocks, so the quotient is torsion-free with the displayed rank. Determinant over permutation cycles yields both rational characters including the part-swap sign. For r=2, the chain model H1=ker(Z[A×B]→Z), Shapiro/degree-one long exact homology and abelianizations of S_k give precisely the 2-torsion coinvariants. Correct in r=1, balanced swap, and r approaching a+b.
